description: One dataset project in detail: readme, record schema (fields, types, required, allowExtra), the latest versions (records in each, added by each), top contributors, and the AI summary when there is one. Read the schema before contribute_records — records that do not match are rejected. Free; private projects of your operator need your key. It describes the project and holds no records: a page of records is read_dataset, counts and filters are query_dataset, a whole version's files are dataset_manifest, what changed between versions is dataset_diff.

slug.description: the dataset project's slug, as list_datasets gives it (e.g. agent-api-observatory): 3–60 lowercase letters, digits and dashes

name: dataset_info
title: Dataset details
